evals.name: output-kind-ignores-directory-names
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The repository has a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web project whose directory is named Worker, a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker project whose directory is named Api, and a class library whose directory is named Services. No containers.json exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-containers.sh against git HEAD, writes containers.json, and renders. The web SDK project is output_kind web, the worker SDK project is output_kind worker, and the class library is not a container.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect-containers.sh rather than classifying projects by hand
Does not treat the directory name Worker, Api, or Services as the output kind
A Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web project is output_kind web
A class library is not a deployable
Writes containers.json before rendering, and does not invent nodes the script omitted

evals.name: modular-monolith-is-one-container
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. One web SDK project references two class libraries through ProjectReference. The libraries' directories are named Billing and Domain.
evals.expected_output: One deployable. Billing and Domain are contained modules, not containers. The diagram names them as containment.
expectations: Emits one deployable for the web SDK project
Records each ProjectReference library as a module of that deployable
Does not draw the libraries as containers
Does not read host-builder calls in source as evidence of another deployable

evals.name: shared-broker-cites-both-keys-and-redacts
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

Two deployables each have a committed appsettings.json whose Broker value is the same sb:// host. One file also has a connection string with Password= and AccountKey=. An untracked appsettings.Local.json names a different host.
evals.expected_output: A shared-infrastructure edge cites both committed config keys. No password, account key, or untracked host appears in the record, the render, or stdout.
expectations: The shared-infrastructure edge evidence names both appsettings files and the Broker key
Does not add an edge only because the two projects share a repository
Password, AccountKey, and token material are absent from every written file and from stdout
The untracked appsettings.Local.json is not read
A store whose runtime was not cited carries technology unknown

evals.name: unset-dialect-writes-no-c4-view
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

diagram_dialect.system is unset. architecture_dir is docs/architecture. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Writes containers.json and containers.md. Does not write a C4 view file. Does not pass mermaid.
expectations: Passes --dialect unset, or omits a C4 dialect, because diagram_dialect.system is unset
Does not pass mermaid; that value is refused
Writes the fact report and no containers.puml or containers.likec4
Stops and points at /architecture:setup when architecture_dir is undeclared and --out was not passed
